subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Students helped survey people using the shaded routes.”?
options: Many said they walked more comfortably and waited for buses with less stress.
Many said it helped them feel less nervous.
Linda said she had folded the paper many times before finding a good shape.
Some students said cheap clothes were helpful for families with less money.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Students helped survey people using the shaded routes. Many said they walked more comfortably and waited for buses with less stress.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Many said it helped them feel less nervous.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Linda said she had folded the paper many times before finding a good shape.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Some students said cheap clothes were helpful for families with less money.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Students helped survey people using the shaded routes. Many said they walked more comfortably and waited for buses with less stress.」，答案為「Many said they walked more comfortably and waited for buses with less stress.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Many said they walked more comfortably and waited for buses with less stress.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
